text:
emily: ACME on call — getting sustained 429s around 09:02-09:15 UTC. They’re on Dedicated (reserved + burst). Symptoms: requests queue then 429s; looks like scale-up didn’t attach new capacity. CS is on the line.

raj: on it. can you paste a sample request id and curl to repro?

emily: sample request id: req_0a3b9f. repro curl: curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"model":"open-r/xx","input":"hello"}'

emily: paste from support logs (09:00-09:10 UTC):
```
attach: failed to attach to pool: iam permission denied (403) token rotation failed at 2025-06-24T09:01:57Z
autoscaler: target=12 current=6 min_replicas=6 max_replicas=50 pending_attach=6
probe: imagepull backoff retry=4/5
```

ingrid: min_replicas is 6. autoscaler saw spike ~80 RPS, expected scale to 12-20. attach failures show 403s from control plane. question: did billing or account controls block burst attaches?

mike: confirmed: account acme-prod has a billing hold flagged 2025-06-24T08:58Z due to PO mismatch. burst_attach flag set to false. forwarding billing ticket #2379 to CS + ops.

raj: control-plane responded with `403 billing_hold: burst_attach_disabled` when creating ephemeral attach tokens — matches attach errors.

ops-bot: Incident created INC-2025-1832 — tags: eng-runtime, billing, customer-success. Priority: P1.

ingrid: short repro for eng-runtime team to validate: 1) run spike against dedicated endpoint 2) watch /autoscaler/metrics and attach-service logs 3) confirm control-plane attach token flow. sample load command:```wrk -t4 -c200 -d60s http://dedicated.acme/api/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\"```

raj: collecting traces + span ids. span s-7fa3c9... attached to ticket along with pod logs 09:00-09:20 UTC.

emily: customer asking for temporary mitigation — can we manually expand warm pool / bump min_replicas?

ingrid: manual bump to min_replicas=12 is possible but requires support + billing bypass to allow temporary capacity beyond reserved. I'll draft the change and queue for approval.

mike: immediate path: finance can clear billing hold (I contacted AP). ETA ~30m. will update ticket.

raj: triage checklist for follow-up: collect failed attach HTTP responses, list affected request ids, export seq logs for root-cause, reproduce in staging with billing_hold enabled to validate behavior, and prepare rollback plan if we manually change min_replicas.

emily: CS updated customer, they’ll wait ~30m for billing clearance. adding notes to the customer ticket and marking this thread. :thumbsup:
